description: Hey, I'm Yaroslav - a Senior .NET Engineer based in Kraków, Poland, with 7+ years of experience building cloud-native applications and distributed systems. I've worked across sustainability, fintech, insurance, and enterprise software, mostly around C#, .NET Core, and Azure - enjoying the full journey from whiteboarding architecture to shipping clean, well-tested code.

Lately I've been taking an active role in supporting engineering leadership - driving delivery ceremonies, shaping team processes, and keeping communication flowing between developers and business stakeholders. I naturally gravitate toward making sure the team has clarity and momentum to do their best work.

Outside of work, I stay active through football, cycling, and swimming, and love travelling whenever I get the chance. A fresh perspective away from the keyboard tends to make you a better engineer anyway.

experience.description: Actively contributed to the execution of a large-scale technical migration for a modular monolith platform. Designed and delivered new product features within a modular monolith architecture, ensuring long-term maintainability and extensibility

Design and delivery of new capabilities across microservice-based applications. Contributed to the migration of legacy systems to Azure cloud infrastructure. Played a key role in establishing engineering processes for a newly formed team, including structured code review standards, standup routines, and delivery ceremonies.

Design and implementation of new capabilities for application primarily using .NET and React. Involved in all stages of the software development lifecycle, from requirements gathering to deployment and maintenance.
Contributed to enterprise software solutions for the banking industry, primarily using .NET technologies. Bug fixing and product maintenance.
